experiment_data.hypothesis: Subgroup-heterogeneous misclassification (Δπ>0.05) is a structural property across diverse open-source LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma2-9B, Mistral-7B), and EC-HTE's coverage advantage over Naive persists under real confusion matrices in semi-synthetic budget sweeps — validating C1 multi-LLM claim
